title: Analista de Dados Pleno
description:
MISSÃO DO CARGO

Ser o elo entre dados e decisões, garantindo que as informações da empresa se transformem em conhecimento estratégico e ações concretas. A pessoa nesta posição será responsável por estruturar, tratar e traduzir dados complexos em análises claras, confiáveis e orientadas ao negócio, contribuindo para elevar a maturidade analítica da organização e apoiar times na tomada de decisão baseada em evidências.


RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Estruturar e tratar dados oriundos de múltiplas fontes, garantindo integridade, padronização e confiabilidade;
  • Construir consultas SQL e pipelines de dados para alimentar relatórios e dashboards;
  • Desenvolver análises exploratórias e diagnósticos para identificar causas, tendências e oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Criar e manter painéis de visualização que comuniquem claramente indicadores e insights de negócio;
  • Apoiar diferentes áreas na tradução de necessidades em soluções analíticas e na definição de métricas e KPIs;
  • Promover a evolução da maturidade analítica e disseminar boas práticas de governança de dados;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com as equipes de processos e sistemas para estruturar dados e automatizar fluxos;
  • Manter documentação atualizada sobre origens de dados, lógicas de tratamento e regras de cálculo.


CONHECIMENTOS E HABILIDADES

  • Domínio em SQL (obrigatório): construção de queries complexas, manipulação e tratamento de dados;
  • Conhecimento prático em ferramentas de visualização;
  • Experiência em modelagem de dados (conceitual e relacional);
  • Conhecimentos em Python ou outra linguagem para análise e automação (desejável);
  • Entendimento de conceitos de governança, qualidade e integração de dados;
  • Capacidade de interpretar contextos de negócio e traduzir em hipóteses analíticas.


Se você quer atuar em projetos desafiadores, com liberdade para propor soluções e contribuir na construção de produtos de alto desempenho, essa vaga é para você!


Localidade | Atuação

Uberlândia/MG: Presencial

São Paulo/SP: Híbrido (2x na semana no escritório)

Demais localidades: Remoto

title: Recruiter I
description:
Somos fanáticos por nossas pessoas! E demonstramos isso oferecendo uma cultura de pertencimento; caminhos claros para o desenvolvimento de carreira; programas de apoio profissional, coaching e mentoria, uma rede global de amigos e colegas que podem te suportar e mais! (Tipo, muito mais.).


Quer estar em uma multinacional que é Great Place to Work, apoiar as melhores marcas do mercado, inovar e mudar o mundo – tudo ao mesmo tempo em que estabelece conexões reais com as pessoas e desenvolve sua carreira?


Seja um #gamechanger Junte-se ao nosso time e vamos tornar isso oficial!

Todas as vagas da Concentrix vagas são elegíveis a Pessoas com Deficiência.


Estamos procurando por um(a) Recruiter I.


O que você fará:


• Responsável por auxiliar na implementação e administração de programas de recrutamento.

• Receber, selecionar e arquivar currículos.

• Conduzir entrevistas de triagem inicial, entrevistas por telefone e/ou entrevistas presenciais com candidatos em potencial.

• Seguir com as ofertas da vaga de acordo com a descrição da conta.

• Acompanhar o candidato desde o processo seletivo até a data de início na empresa.

title: SAP Basis Consultant
description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Your role and responsibilities:


  • Ensure SLA adherence and process compliance (ITIL awareness)
  • Mentor and train team members
  • Handle tickets, perform root cause analysis, and troubleshoot technical issues
  • Lead installation, configuration, migration, and upgrade activities
  • Define and enforce operational processes
  • Maximize system uptime and manage BASIS activities
  • Collaborate with functional teams on cutover strategies and post-implementation support


Technical Expertise:


  • SAP server installation/configuration (ABAP, Java, ABAP+Java stacks)
  • High Availability setup (Unix/Windows)
  • SAP BASIS server administration and RCA for escalated issues
  • Kickstart environment setup and maintenance
  • End-to-end SAP lifecycle implementations for global clients
  • SAP version and EHP upgrades
  • Performance tuning, capacity planning, and troubleshooting across app, DB, and OS
  • Strong understanding of NetWeaver components (EP, PI, BI, ECC, CRM, SRM, SolMan, TREX, MDM)
  • Oracle DB, BRTools, SAP HANA DB, Sybase ASE, Linux/Windows admin
  • Advanced English


Soft Skills:


  • Excellent verbal and written communication
  • Strong documentation and MS Office skills (Project, Visio)
  • Customer-centric mindset with high adaptability
  • Ability to manage unforeseen situations and drive value


Additional Experience:


  • Production systems and data center operations
  • Server migration, patching, and upgrade experience


Certifications Preferred:


SAP BASIS, NetWeaver, Solution Manager, OS/DB Migration


Please submit resumé in English.


Why choose us?


We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented

We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues from all over the world

We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good integration between your work and personal life, with real flexibility

We are committed to your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at all levels to help you find your unique brilliance. We offer comprehensive benefits to all employees

We are certified as a "Great Place to Work" and "Top Employer" in 17 countries, and recognized as a “Top Employer” in Brazil specifically, offering a positive work environment that values employee recognition and respect


Equality & Opportunity for All


Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws

title: Marketing Automation & Integration Engineer
description:
We are seeking a highly motivated Marketing Automation & Integration Engineer to join our team.


Our Client is one of the United States’ largest insurers, providing a wide range of insurance and financial services products with gross written premiums well over US$25 Billion (P&C). They proudly serve more than 10 million U.S. households with more than 19 million individual policies across all 50 states through the efforts of over 48,000 exclusive and independent agents and nearly 18,500 employees. Finally, our Client is part of one the largest Insurance Groups in the world.


What to expect on your journey with us:

  • A solid and innovative company with a strong market presence
  • A dynamic, diverse, and multicultural work environment
  • Leaders with deep market knowledge and strategic vision
  • Continuous learning and development


Team Function:

The team is responsible for architecting and maintaining scalable MarTech solutions, with a focus on:

- Data integration

- Customer journey orchestration

- Marketing automation

This team operates within the Data, Tech, and Operations tower of the Direct BU.


Role Description:

This role centers on the implementation and optimization of a MarTech data flow pattern involving Snowflake, Segment, Braze, and other SaaS platforms.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Design and maintain data pipelines between Snowflake, Segment CDP, Braze, and additional platforms
  • Implement real-time and batch data ingestion strategies
  • Manage customer event tracking and identity resolution within Segment
  • Orchestrate personalized marketing campaigns in Braze using dynamic segmentation and behavioral triggers
  • Ensure data integrity and feedback loops from Braze back into Snowflake via Segment
  • Automate data transformations and enrichment using scripting languages
  • Monitor system performance and troubleshoot integration issues across platforms


Requirements


  • 4 to 6 years of experience in IT environments with a strong focus on MarTech architecture.
  • Familiarity with insurance industry data and customer lifecycle models is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/IT, Data Science, Software Engineering.
  • Fluency in English


Software / Tools

  • Segment CDP
  • Braze
  • Snowflake
  • Scripting Languages (Python / JS)


Other Critical Skills

  • Reverse ETL
  • Data Orchestration Platforms
  • Customer Data Schema Design
  • Consent & Preference Management
  • Data modeling and ETL/ELT Pipeline
  • API Integrations / Webhooks
  • Customer journey mapping and automation logic


Benefits


This position comes with competitive compensation and benefits package:

  • Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • Career development and training opportunities
  • Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office-based)
  • Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally reknowned group
  • Private Health Insurance
  • Pension Plan
  • Paid Time Off
  • Training & Development

title: Analista de negócios em TI - Hibrido
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga:


Analista de Negócios Senior (IT Business Partner) - Hibrida


O que oferecemos a você:

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas

- Auxílio creche

- Seguro de vida

- Desconto em terapia: plataforma de apoio psicossocial

- Parceria com instituições de ensino

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas

- Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

Você será responsável por desenhar e implementar soluções tecnológicas completas (end-to-end) , garantindo o alinhamento com as estratégias globais e a entrega de valor ao negócio. Atuará como ponte entre times de TI e áreas de negócio , contribuindo para a transformação digital e o fortalecimento da arquitetura corporativa.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência sólida em arquitetura de soluções e integração de sistemas (SAP e não-SAP)
  • Conhecimento em processos de TI, governança e desenho técnico de soluções (USDD)
  • Atuação em ambientes ágeis (Squads) e domínio de frameworks de portfólio
  • Habilidade para atuar como elo entre negócio e tecnologia
  • Inglês Intermediário/Avançado (mínimo B2)


Formação Acadêmica: Nível superior completo.


O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right.


Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a motivated, ambitious Graphic Designer to join our growing team!


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Our business is expanding globally, and we need talented folks on our team to continue offering stellar service to our clients.


Running a company is a little like building a plane while flying it. There’s always too much to do; doing one thing means neglecting something else. You have to blog but also be active on social media. You have to build websites and then optimize them for mobile. Email lists. Emails. Keywords. SEM. SEO. UX. UI. FML. OMG. That’s where we come in. We provide an unlimited get-shit-done subscription for our clients. And we need your help!


Key Responsibilities

  • Create visually appealing designs for various platforms, including digital, print, social media, and branding.
  • Use AI tools and design software to streamline the design process, generate ideas, and automate repetitive tasks, ensuring fresh and innovative results.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (marketing, content, etc.) to deliver high-quality design solutions that align with brand guidelines and project goals.
  • Work on design projects from start to finish, ensuring designs are on-brand, on-time, and meet all requirements.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest design trends, tools, and AI technologies to keep your work innovative and relevant.
  • Edit and optimize designs for various media, ensuring the best quality and user experience across devices.


Qualifications

  • Strong experience as a graphic designer, with a portfolio showcasing your skills in visual design, creativity, and problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in design software like Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), Canva, Figma, or similar tools.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft programs (PowerPoint and Word)
  • Familiarity with AI-powered design tools (such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Nanobanana, Midjourney, Firefly, Freepik AI, etc.) and an eagerness to explore new AI technologies.
  • Understanding of digital design principles for social media, websites, and other online platforms.
  • Understanding of small-scale and large-scale print materials (such as business cards, flyers, menus, conference collateral, merchandise, banners, backdrops, etc.)
  • Ability to work efficiently, meet deadlines, and manage multiple design projects simultaneously.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with team members.
  • A working level of written and spoken English


Our operating hours are 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. MST, Monday to Friday.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: LLM Engineer
description:
Our client, an international AI development company based in New York, is currently seeking a "LLM Engineer " to lead strategic product development efforts in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.


This role will focus on implementing scalable vector store integrations, building retrieval pipelines, and enabling advanced communication protocols between intelligent agents.

Key Responsibilities

RAG & VectorStore Systems:

Build and maintain end-to-end RAG pipelines for context-augmented generation

Integrate and optimize vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus)

Support the engineering backbone of agentic and RAG-based AI systems

Protocol Engineering:

Implement Model Context Protocol (MCP) to maintain stateful LLM interactions

Build Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication layers for multi-agent orchestration

Enable persistent memory and context sharing across model calls

Platform Enablement:

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to productionize models and workflows

Ensure seamless data flow and model integration across services

Qualifications & Skills

Deep experience with vector databases and RAG architecture

Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and A2A (Agent-to-Agent) design patterns

Solid background in Python, cloud-based ML pipelines, and containerization tools

Experience in operationalizing LLM-based systems in production

Detail-oriented with a strong engineering mindset

Effective communicator with technical and non-technical stakeholders

Self-driven and adaptable in a fast-paced R&D environment

Very strong English communication skills, both written and verbal (essential for global collaboration)

Experience with Contract Analysis and automated document understanding

Nice to Have:

Experience with invoice parsing / invoice understanding, including extracting structured data from financial documents

Experience in NLP-to-SQL, natural language querying, or generating structured database queries from unstructured text

Familiarity with legal-tech, document intelligence, or enterprise knowledge extraction systems

Experience with observability, vector hygiene, and evaluation frameworks for RAG/agentic systems

Hands-on work with high-throughput, low-latency AI pipelines

title: Iteration Video Editor
description:
Who We Are

Mindful Agency is a performance-driven creative team specializing in high-converting Meta ads for top tech brands. We’re looking for an Iterations Editor—someone who can take fully edited 30–60 second Meta ads and generate multiple high-quality variations designed to increase performance, improve hook testing, and expand creative volume.


This role is not standard editing. It requires someone who understands creative iteration as a scientific process: isolating variables, modifying structure and pacing, and generating new variants that give Meta’s algorithm more opportunities to find winners.


What You’ll Do
  • Open existing fully-edited Premiere Pro project files and generate new, distinct iterations of the same ad.
  • Create alternative hooks, shorten or re-structure timelines, adjust pacing, and introduce new punch-in/out moments to increase stopping power.
  • Modify captions, layout, on-screen text, reframing, b-roll timing, and transitions while keeping brand consistency intact.
  • Produce multiple versions of each ad optimized for performance testing (length trims, hook variations, CTA variations).
  • Ensure all variations are export-ready, cleanly organized, and aligned with Mindful Agency’s internal workflow in Notion and Google Drive.
  • Collaborate asynchronously with the creative team to understand each ad’s strategic goal (problem-solution, testimonial, UGC pacing, value prop emphasis).
  • Maintain consistent daily output based on clear production expectations and deliverables.


Requirements
  • Expert-level proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro (must be comfortable navigating another editor’s timeline, proxies, nests, captions, and media management).
  • Strong understanding of direct-response video editing, ideally with experience in Meta/TikTok ad formats.
  • Ability to identify and modify high-leverage creative variables: hook strength, pacing, text placement, dynamic framing, and overall watch-through optimization.
  • Strong creative instincts paired with a scientific mindset—able to think in terms of tests, variants, and performance hypotheses.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to produce clean, organized sequences that integrate back into our workflow.
  • Fast, reliable communication and ability to work independently across global time zones.
  • Portfolio demonstrating short-form ads or UGC-style edits (required).


Nice-to-Haves
  • Experience with direct-response brands, SaaS, tech, or e-commerce.
  • Familiarity with Meta ad performance patterns (retention curves, thumb-stop theory, hook testing).
  • Motion graphics or caption stylization skills for added variation when needed.


Why Work With Mindful
  • Work with a fast-growing US-based performance agency that values craftsmanship and creativity.
  • Clear workflows, predictable task structure, and objective editing metrics.
  • Long-term opportunity with consistent volume of work.

Job Title: Senior Training Coordinator (SuccessFactors)


Job Overview:


We are seeking an LMS Analyst with basic experience in SAP SuccessFactors to support our LMS team in optimizing our human resource processes. The ideal candidate will assist with system configuration, data management, and reporting, contributing to the overall effectiveness of our LMS operations.


Key Responsibilities:


  • · Assist in the administration and configuration of SuccessFactors modules, including Employee Central, Performance & Goals, and Learning Management.

  • · Support data entry, data management, and data integrity within the SuccessFactors system.
  • · Generate standard and ad-hoc reports to analyze LMS metrics and support decision-making.
  • · Collaborate with LMS team members to streamline processes and improve user experience within the system.
  • · Participate in user training sessions and provide support to end-users as needed.
  • · Help troubleshoot system issues and coordinate with IT or SuccessFactors support for resolution.


Qualifications:


  • · Basic understanding of SAP SuccessFactors, with experience in one or more modules preferred.
  • · Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • · Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • · Familiarity with LMS processes and practices is a plus.
  • · Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel.


Education:


  • · Bachelor’s degree in any stream, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
  • Experience:
  • · Previous experience in LMS or LMSIS support is a plus, but not required.

  • · This position may be remote or in-office, depending on company policy.

  • · Opportunities for training and professional development in SuccessFactors and other LMS technologies.

title: Gestor de tráfego - Meta Ads - Webinários
description:
Gestor de Tráfego Pago, Webinarsios, EverWebinar.


O que vai fazer

• Planejar e operar tráfego para funis e Webinários no EverWebinar. (É muito similar a rodar tráfego para uma VSL.

• Mercado Americano.

• Configurar e validar pixels.

• Criar, testar e otimizar campanhas em Meta Ads segmentação local nos EUA

• Definir orçamentos, pacing e metas, CPL, CPA, ROAS.

• Montar UTMs, dashboards simples em Sheets, leitura de números e tomada de decisão.

• Apoiar páginas simples, landing e checkout, noções de hospedagem e DNS.

• Integrar tráfego com CRM, email e SMS para aumentar comparecimento no webinar.


Requisitos

• Experiência prática em performance, Meta Ads e funis de captação.

• Inglês intermediário para ler métricas, interfaces e materiais.

• Noção de configuração básica de site e hospedagem

• Comunicação clara, disciplina com processos e prazos,


Diferenciais

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Our AI startup has been featured on VICE, New York Times, Futurism, Fox News, and more for disrupting our industry. We are hiring an engineer!


We still operate in stealth so we aren't able to discuss exactly what we do until you are selected for an interview directly with our CTO, but here is what we can share:


About us

We are already the biggest AI company in our niche.


Why you should join us

  • 100% remote
  • You decide your working hours
  • Complete ownership of projects
  • No micromanaging whatsoever
  • Exciting unsolved engineering problems
  • You will build with the CTO daily and directly report to our CEO
  • Huge growth and leadership potential
  • Competitive salary


Who we are looking for

  • Top 1% problem solving
  • Top 1% in learning anything speed
  • Desire to lead a team of engineers in the future
  • We are an international team, international applicants are OK!


To summarize we are looking for an extremely talented engineer that can thrive an independent remote environment. We select our engineers with great care because we know our hires may eventually lead the engineering team and hire more people like themself.


Useful technical skills (not required)

  • General AI understanding
  • Reverse engineering
  • Chrome extensions
  • PostgreSQL
  • Typescript
  • Python
  • Django
  • React
  • LLMs
  • GCP
  • NLP


We are looking to hire talent as soon as possible, if you have a strong application expect to hear from us and get an interview with our CTO within a day or two.

title: L2 - Security Engineer (EDR Solutions)
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.


Job Title: L2 Security Engineer - EDR Solutions (CrowdStrike, Palo Alto XDR, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, SentinelOne)

Location: Hybrid, 24x7 Shifts

Job Type: Full-Time (Rotational Shift Model, including weekends and holidays)


Job Summary:

As an L2 Security Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of EDR solutions by monitoring platform health, enforcing security policies, and troubleshooting endpoint issues across multiple EDR platforms including CrowdStrike, Palo Alto XDR, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, and SentinelOne. Your role includes onboarding devices, validating security rules, handling basic policy enforcement issues, and ensuring that all endpoints remain compliant with security baselines. You will assist in resolving connectivity issues, missing telemetry cases, and agent health checks while escalating complex platform-related problems to L3.


Key Responsibilities:

· Ensure endpoints are successfully onboarded to EDR solutions across all platforms (Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android).

· Monitor endpoint connectivity and health status within the EDR portals.

· Validate that security rules, EDR, and antivirus policies are applied correctly.

· Assist in troubleshooting policy conflicts and enforcement issues.

· Investigate and validate EDR alerts, classify threats, and escalate incidents if required.

· Apply basic remediation steps like isolating devices, initiating scans, or triggering automated investigations.

· Identify endpoints not reporting telemetry or experiencing EDR agent failures.

· Perform basic troubleshooting (e.g., restarting services, re-onboarding devices, checking connectivity).

· Escalate complex security incidents and persistent issues to L3.

· Assist in preparing incident summaries and compliance reports for management.

· Ensure endpoints are running the latest security patches and EDR updates.

· Validate compliance with security baselines and recommend corrective actions.

· Collaborate with global SOC, Threat Hunting, and Incident Response teams for critical security incidents.


Required Skills & Knowledge:

· Hands-on expertise in CrowdStrike, Palo Alto XDR, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, and SentinelOne.

· Ability to analyze malware behaviors, execute incident containment strategies, and escalate threats appropriately.

· Scripting knowledge in PowerShell or Python (preferred).

· Strong analytical, documentation, and communication skills.


Work Environment & Shift Requirements:

· 24x7 support model with rotational shifts (including nights, weekends, and holidays).

· Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure SOC environment.

· Excellent collaboration and coordination with global cybersecurity teams.


Preferred Certifications:

· CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Administrator (CCFA)

· Palo Alto Networks Certified Cybersecurity Associate (PCCSA)

· Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200)

· SentinelOne Certified Administrator


At HCLTech, we don’t just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Join a global team where your work drives innovation, your ideas matter, and your growth is supported every step of the way.


Why Choose HCLTech?

  • Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint
  • Collaborate with diverse teams across borders
  • Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration
  • Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion

title: Profissional Product Owner
description:
BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


Ei Profissional venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!



  • O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


  • O que você deve ter?


Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

Experiência com métricas de produto e discovery.

Atuação em softwares de larga escala ou modernização de aplicações.

Utilização de ferramentas IA como aceleradoras

Diferenciais: Certificação como PSPO, CSPO ou equivalente.


3x na semana presencial


O que temos pra te oferecer?

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
QAT Global , a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience, is seeking a highly skilled Fullstack Developer to join our global team. We are proud to deliver world-class technology solutions with teams across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil.

This is a full-time, 100% remote position (CLT hire in Brazil only) , offering the opportunity to work directly with our US-based customer and collaborate with international development teams.


About the Role:


As a Fullstack Developer , you will be responsible for building and maintaining robust, scalable, and secure applications across both front-end and back-end components. You will work closely with designers, engineers, product owners, and technical leads to deliver high-quality solutions aligned with modern engineering best practices.

This role is ideal for someone with strong expertise in .NET Core and Angular, experience working with distributed architectures, APIs, microservices, and Azure cloud services.


Responsibilities:


  • Develop and maintain fullstack applications (front-end and back-end).
  • Implement and integrate APIs with Cosmos DB, Event Bus, and Web App Services.
  • Ensure application performance, security, and scalability.
  • Work on CI/CD deployment pipelines in collaboration with the Tech Lead.
  • Collaborate effectively with cross-functional, distributed teams.


Required Qualifications:


  • Backend: .NET Core (C#), Web API
  • Frontend: Angular, TypeScript
  • Databases: Cosmos DB, SQL Server
  • Nice to Have: Postgres
  • Microservices: Experience with containerized applications (Docker)
  • Azure Services: Azure Service Bus
  • DevOps & CI/CD: Experience with Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions
  • Testing: Unit and integration testing (xUnit, Jest, Mocha)
  • Communication: Strong English communication skills and ability to collaborate with global teams


Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have):

  • BS/MS in Systems Analysis and Development, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields.
company: QAT Global | Custom Software Development & IT Staffing Solutions - US, Brazil & Costa Rica Nearshore

title: Líder de projetos
description:
OBJETIVO DA POSIÇÃO:

  • Garantir o cumprimento dos prazos, orçamentos e padrões de qualidade estabelecidos para assegurar a excelência na entrega
  • Assegurar que a comunicação esteja alinhada às normas regulatórias e às boas práticas clínicas (GCP)
  • Identificar e propor soluções estratégicas, promovendo a eficiência operacional em todas as fases dos projetos, atuando de forma preventiva, se antecipando na identificação de riscos


PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Liderar todas as etapas dos estudos clínicos e atividades de monitoria, sob sua gestão
  • Estruturar cronogramas das atividades de estudos clínicos e garantir plena adesão aos cronogramas
  • Manter comunicação eficaz e assertiva com equipe do estudo, antecipando problemas e discutindo melhores estratégias e prioridades
  • Avaliar riscos e implementar medidas corretivas quando necessário, para manter o andamento do estudo
  • Apoiar as Gerentes de: Projetos e Operações Clínicas na gestão de recursos, para garantir a execução do estudo conforme o planejado.
  • Atuar como mentor dos CRA’s
  • Revisar os relatórios de visitas de monitoramento dos CRA’s e métricas de visitas de monitoramento, incluindo desvios de protocolo e itens de acompanhamento, para avaliar conformidade e tendências
  • Gerenciar o progresso dos estudos atribuídos rastreando submissões e aprovações regulatórias, recrutamento e elegibilidade, preenchimento da CRF e geração e resolução de queries.
  • Desenvolver materiais como plano de monitoria, apresentação de SIV, Newsletter e ferramentas para auxílio no processo de suas atividades, auxílio em processo contratual, apresentações em meeting de investigadores
  • Participar na preparação e na execução de auditorias e nas atividades de acompanhamento, conforme necessário


REQUISITOS DA POSIÇÃO:

- Formação Acadêmica:

  • Curso superior completo na área da Saúde: Farmácia, Biomedicina, Fisioterapia, entre outros
  • Formação em Pesquisa Clínica será considerado diferencial
  • Especialização /pós-graduação em gestão de projetos ou semelhante será um diferencial


- Requisitos Técnicos

  • Conhecimento das Boas Práticas Clínicas (GCP) e diretrizes regulatórias aplicáveis em Pesquisa Clínica
  • Conhecimentos de processo regulatório de estudos, incluindo documentos essenciais e ANVISA
  • Conhecimento em Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint e Outlook)
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas ou apps de gestão de projetos, gestão de tarefas


- Experiência:

  • Experiência em pesquisa clínica de no mínimo 6 anos, especialmente em gerenciamento de Centros e Monitoria


- Idiomas

  • Inglês – Obrigatório - Avançado
  • Espanhol - Obrigatório - Avançado


OBS.: DISPONIBILIDADE PARA VIAJAR MINIMAMENTE 40% do tempo


- Soft Skills:

  • Comunicação
  • Proatividade
  • Trabalho em equipe
  • Adaptabilidade
  • Relacionamento interpessoal
  • Fortes habilidades de liderança e capacidade de coordenar e liderar equipes locais para alto desempenho técnico

  • Assegurar que a comunicação esteja alinhada às normas regulatórias e às boas práticas clínicas (GCP)
  • Identificar e propor soluções estratégicas, promovendo a eficiência operacional em todas as fases dos projetos, atuando de forma preventiva, se antecipando na identificação de riscos


PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Liderar todas as etapas dos estudos clínicos e atividades de monitoria, sob sua gestão
  • Estruturar cronogramas das atividades de estudos clínicos e garantir plena adesão aos cronogramas
  • Manter comunicação eficaz e assertiva com equipe do estudo, antecipando problemas e discutindo melhores estratégias e prioridades
  • Avaliar riscos e implementar medidas corretivas quando necessário, para manter o andamento do estudo
  • Apoiar as Gerentes de: Projetos e Operações Clínicas na gestão de recursos, para garantir a execução do estudo conforme o planejado.
  • Atuar como mentor dos CRA’s
  • Revisar os relatórios de visitas de monitoramento dos CRA’s e métricas de visitas de monitoramento, incluindo desvios de protocolo e itens de acompanhamento, para avaliar conformidade e tendências
  • Gerenciar o progresso dos estudos atribuídos rastreando submissões e aprovações regulatórias, recrutamento e elegibilidade, preenchimento da CRF e geração e resolução de queries.
  • Desenvolver materiais como plano de monitoria, apresentação de SIV, Newsletter e ferramentas para auxílio no processo de suas atividades, auxílio em processo contratual, apresentações em meeting de investigadores
  • Participar na preparação e na execução de auditorias e nas atividades de acompanhamento, conforme necessário


REQUISITOS DA POSIÇÃO:

- Formação Acadêmica:

  • Curso superior completo na área da Saúde: Farmácia, Biomedicina, Fisioterapia, entre outros
  • Formação em Pesquisa Clínica será considerado diferencial
  • Especialização /pós-graduação em gestão de projetos ou semelhante será um diferencial


- Requisitos Técnicos

  • Conhecimento das Boas Práticas Clínicas (GCP) e diretrizes regulatórias aplicáveis em Pesquisa Clínica
  • Conhecimentos de processo regulatório de estudos, incluindo documentos essenciais e ANVISA
  • Conhecimento em Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint e Outlook)
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas ou apps de gestão de projetos, gestão de tarefas


- Experiência:

  • Experiência em pesquisa clínica de no mínimo 6 anos, especialmente em gerenciamento de Centros e Monitoria


- Idiomas

  • Inglês – Obrigatório - Avançado
  • Espanhol - Obrigatório - Avançado


OBS.: DISPONIBILIDADE PARA VIAJAR MINIMAMENTE 40% do tempo


- Soft Skills:

  • Comunicação
  • Proatividade
  • Trabalho em equipe
  • Adaptabilidade
  • Relacionamento interpessoal
  • Fortes habilidades de liderança e capacidade de coordenar e liderar equipes locais para alto desempenho técnico

title: Gerente de Vendas
description:
A Zoomlion Brasil, multinacional com forte atuação global nos segmentos de máquinas pesadas, está com processo seletivo aberto para a posição de Gerente de Vendas no Brasil.


Esta é uma oportunidade estratégica para profissionais com sólida experiência no setor, perfil de liderança e visão comercial orientada a resultados.


Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar a equipe nacional de vendas, promovendo o desenvolvimento comercial dos profissionais;
  • Definir estratégias comerciais alinhadas ao posicionamento global da empresa e às demandas do mercado brasileiro;
  • Gerenciar metas, indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e relatórios de performance;
  • Identificar oportunidades de expansão de mercado e novos canais de distribuição;
  • Atuar diretamente na negociação com grandes contas e parceiros estratégicos;
  • Representar a empresa em feiras, eventos e visitas institucionais, mantendo relacionamento próximo com clientes e stakeholders.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Ensino superior completo (Administração, Engenharia, ou áreas correlatas);
  • Inglês avançado (interações frequentes com a matriz e equipes globais);
  • Experiência comprovada na função de gerência comercial em empresas do segmento de máquinas pesadas;
  • Histórico de liderança de equipes comerciais e gestão de territórios nacionais;
  • Conhecimento do mercado brasileiro, canais de distribuição e estratégias de penetração comercial.

title: Assistente de Design
description:
Sobre o Grupo EWZ:

Somos um grupo de soluções financeiras em constante crescimento. Composto pelas marcas EWZ Capital, Mundo Invest e Ilha Forte, acreditamos no poder da inovação, da excelência e do design estratégico para gerar resultados. Agora, buscamos um(a) novo(a) Assistente de Design para reforçar nosso time criativo.


O que você irá fazer:

• Criar criativos para anúncios (meta ads, Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, etc.), garantindo consistência com o posicionamento visual das marcas (EWZ Capital, Ilha Fort e Mundo Invest).

• Desenvolver peças institucionais internas (apresentações, relatórios, templates e comunicações internas).

• Cuidar da identidade visual digital , garantindo coesão entre site, landing pages e campanhas.

• Apoiar o time de marketing e tecnologia na experiência do usuário (UX) e interface (UI) dos sites e sistemas internos.

• Adaptar conteúdos para diferentes canais (social, e-mail, web) com foco em performance e conversão.

• Manter uma biblioteca organizada de assets, templates e guidelines visuais.

• Acompanhar métricas de desempenho dos criativos (CTR, CPC, conversão) em conjunto com o time de mídia.


O que esperamos de você:

• Formação (concluída ou em andamento) em Design Gráfico, Publicidade ou áreas correlatas.

• Domínio de Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator).

• Conhecimento em Figma (obrigatório).

• Organização, atenção aos detalhes e boa comunicação.

• Perfil criativo, curioso, proativo e colaborativo.


Diferenciais:

• Vivência com criação para tráfego pago e redes sociais .

• Experiência prévia no mercado financeiro.

• Experiência básica em projetos de UX/UI (wireframes, protótipos, landing pages).

• Familiaridade com criação orientada a dados e KPIs de performance.


Vaga 100% presencial em Pinheiros, São Paulo.


Se você se identifica com esse perfil e quer crescer em um time dinâmico e inovador, essa vaga é pra você!

title: Graphic Designer
description:
US Company is hiring a Graphic Designer | Remote (LATAM) | Professional English | Full-Time


A high-growth performance marketing agency is looking for a talented Graphic Designer who understands the intersection of data and art.


We are looking for a candidate with impeccable taste and a deep understanding of the direct-to-consumer (DTC) e-commerce landscape. You will be responsible for researching competitors, identifying winning visual trends, and producing high-quality ad creatives that stop the scroll.


Responsibilities:


  • Create high-conversion ad creatives, including static images, carousels, and GIFs for paid social platforms.
  • Conduct ongoing research on competitor ads and market trends to identify effective visual concepts and adapt them for client campaigns.
  • Develop multiple iterations of the same creative concept, testing variations in typography, visual hierarchy, and layout to maximize performance.
  • Maintain organized files, asset libraries, and version control to enable fast and efficient creative production.


Requirements:


  • Previous experience working with e-commerce brands or within a performance marketing agency, focused on creating ad creatives.
  • A mandatory portfolio showcasing real creatives used in live campaigns (applications without a portfolio will not be considered).
  • Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Figma, After Effects, Asana, Slack, Foreplay, Meta Ad Library.
  • Professional English (B2/C1+)
  • The portfolio must demonstrate strong typography skills . Outdated fonts, generic selections, or poor spacing are considered disqualifying.

title: LATAM Customer Success Manager
description:
About Prometheus Group

Prometheus Group is a team of self-starters centered on being resourceful, accountable, and results focused. Career progress is based on merit and not years of service or attaining certifications. Our drive and dedication to creating great products for our global customers are at the heart of all we do! In joining Prometheus, you will become a part of the largest global provider of comprehensive enterprise asset management (EAM) software solutions that support the management life cycle for equipment maintenance and operations.


Job Overview:

Prometheus Group’s Customer Success Department is looking for a Customer Success Manager to join our growing team. In this role you will be responsible for understanding our customer base, increasing customer engagement and retention. You will connect with our customer base daily to identify key stakeholders and establish a collaborative relationship between our organization and our customers’. title: Customer Success Specialist, Life Sciences
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


As a Customer Success Specialist, you will help professors at leading universities in the US integrate JoVE videos into their courses to improve teaching outcomes and student success. You'll play a key role in ensuring users get the most value from their JoVE subscription.



Responsibilities:


  • Conduct daily outreach to Faculty (via calls, emails, and 1:1 demos) to set up JoVE integrations in courses and increase product usage.
  • Increase JoVE adoption by delivering product awareness sessions across existing customer universities and research institutes.
  • Grow engagement and usage by delivering presentations at (1) exhibits and conferences, (2) university seminars and workshops, and (3) onsite customer visits.
  • Strengthen subscription renewal outcomes by ensuring smooth implementation support, and consistent usage of JoVE resources.
  • Influence product decisions by communicating customer feedback to sales, product, and marketing teams.


Requirements:


  • A Master's degree or PhD in Life Science disciplines.
  • 1-3 years of experience in customer facing roles is preferred.
  • Fluent communication skills English.
  • Knowledge of education, market trends, and challenges in assigned content areas i.e. Biology, Chemistry, Medicine, Physics, Engineering, or Psychology.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a passion for remote relationship-building.
  • Experience in networking using cold calling is preferred.


Please share your resume in English.


Why Join JoVE?


  • You can expect compensation packages competitively placed within the local market.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Senior Full-Stack / Platform Engineer (Stealth Healthcare AI Startup)
description:
Who we are

We're a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup reinventing how medical practices capture revenue. Backed by experienced founders and already live with our first client, we're building AI-driven tools that automate clinical documentation, coding, and billing — helping clinics recover revenue and improve care.

We're looking for an engineer to help build our core platform end-to-end: backend services, data flows, infrastructure, and modern frontends. You’ll work directly with founders to shape architecture, ship features fast, and turn complex healthcare workflows into intuitive products.


What you'll do

  • Build and evolve full-stack platform components (backend, pipelines, frontend)
  • Develop AI-driven features for clinical and financial data
  • Architect scalable, secure infrastructure on AWS
  • Implement clean, observable data flows for ML/LLMs
  • Ship features from 0→1 and influence product direction


Must-have Skills

  • Strong programming skills (any modern language)
  • Experience with AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform
  • Experience building platform or product from scratch
  • SQL + data modeling
  • Experience with streaming, queues, or event-driven systems
  • Startup mindset: autonomy, speed, ownership


Nice-to-haves

  • Go or Python
  • Clean architecture / DDD
  • AI/ML or LLM pipeline experience
  • Healthcare tech (EHR, RCM)
  • HIPAA / PHI security
  • HL7/FHIR/X12


Why join us

  • Build meaningful, mission-critical healthcare AI
  • Work with a small, high-caliber founding team
  • Competitive comp + meaningful ownership
  • Flexible, modern work environment


If you're excited about leveraging AI to solve complex healthcare challenges and building technology that makes a real difference for providers and patients, we want to hear from you!

title: UX researcher
description:
UX Researcher - Education & Healthcare Portfolio

We're looking for a UX Researcher to join a large, global education and healthcare product portfolio spanning medical, nursing, and higher-education markets. Our products are used by students, faculty, administrators, and librarians across the U.S. and internationally, with most sold B2B to institutions and some B2C offerings.

You'll join an established UX Research team working closely with product managers and designers across multiple product lines. This role requires someone who can quickly learn complex domains, work independently, and run full end-to-end research cycles.

What You'll Do
  • Own and deliver user research across discovery, concept testing, and usability (roughly 30% / 40% / 30% split).
  • Plan, design, and execute studies using appropriate qualitative and evaluative methods.
  • Collaborate closely with PMs and UX designers embedded in U.S.-based product teams.
  • Communicate findings clearly through strong storytelling, presentations, and research artifacts.
  • Bring stakeholders along in the research process-ensuring alignment, transparency, and impact.
  • Work independently after onboarding, while staying connected to an 8-person research team.
  • Help inform product strategy across a diverse, multi-product portfolio.
What We're Looking For
  • Strong UX research experience (not mixed UX design/research), with a solid grasp of research methods and study design.
  • Ability to independently run end-to-end research-from planning through recruiting, fieldwork, analysis, and presenting insights.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams and influencing product decisions.
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to present insights in engaging, structured ways.
  • A team-oriented mindset and a proactive, self-directed working style.
  • Bonus: experience working with international teams and/or education or healthcare domains.
Contract Details
  • Initial 6-month contract, with ongoing extensions expected (projects run 12+ months).
  • Working closely with U.S. teams; LATAM timezone alignment is a plus.
  • Looking to hire 1-2 researchers for January start.

title: Engenheiro de Dados - Remoto
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga: Engenheiro de Dados - Remoto.


O que oferecemos a você:

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas

- Auxílio creche

- Seguro de vida

- Parceria com instituições de ensino

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas

- Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

Projeto de desenvolvimento e melhorias em sistemas bancários.


O que esperamos de você:

Conhecimentos:

• Programação;

• Tratamento de Dados.

Linguagens:

• Python;

• PySpark;

• SQL.

Ferramentas:

• Big Data:

• HUE;

• Hive;

• Spark (SparkML);

• NIFI.

Banco de Dados:

• DB2;

• MySQL;

• Oracle;

• Dbeaver (Ferramenta de Consulta).

• Modelagem de Dados (Erwin)

• Versionamento de código (Git)


O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
Remote - full or part-time


Ego Eimi is building a global productivity ecosystem – software people actually love to use. We value agency, clarity, and adults who don’t need hand-holding.


We’re looking for a Digital Marketing Specialist focused on Meta Ads and Google Ads to help us (and our clients) grow through high-quality performance marketing.


This is a project-based, long-term collaboration (not a traditional full-time job). You’ll be paid per project, with a monthly budget per project. If you’re efficient, you can handle 2–3 projects at once and increase your earnings accordingly.


What you’ll do

You will own performance marketing for the projects you take on, end-to-end:

  • Plan, launch and manage Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns (search, performance, and/or social).
  • Write clear, persuasive ad copy tailored to each audience and funnel stage.
  • Structure and optimize campaigns (bids, audiences, keywords, creatives) for ROI and scalability .
  • Set up and maintain tracking, pixels, and basic analytics to measure results.
  • Run A/B tests on ads, landing pages (with the team) and audiences, and document learnings.
  • Turn data into simple, written updates : what happened, why it matters, and what you’ll do next.
  • Work async, manage your own time, and proactively flag problems or opportunities.


No endless meetings. We just expect one message per workday : what you did yesterday, what you’ll do today, and any blockers.


You might be a great fit if you:

  • ✅ Are proficient with Meta Ads and Google Ads (hands-on, not just theory).
  • ✅ Have strong written English and good listening/reading skills
  • (You do not need to speak English fluently or be on calls.)
  • ✅ Have experience with campaign management and copywriting for paid media.
  • ✅ Are organized, self-managing, and comfortable working with minimal supervision.
  • ✅ Are proactive: when you’re stuck or see a problem, you raise it and propose options.
  • ✅ Have a public portfolio with at least 2 projects showing: what you did, the numbers/results (ROAS, CPL, leads, revenue, etc.), and any key learnings.


We like working with people who:

  • Act like owners, not task-takers.
  • Focus on making something people actually want, not just “running ads”.
  • Treat others with respect, honesty, and professionalism.


How we work & how you get paid

  • Engagement type: project-based contractor/freelancer.
  • Payment model: per project, with a monthly budget agreed upfront.
  • Project length: usually longer than 1 month.
  • Workload: you can take on multiple projects (e.g. 2–3) depending on your efficiency and results.
  • Meetings: almost none. Communication is asynchronous, mostly in writing.


If you want autonomy, hate micromanagement, and enjoy being judged by your results , you’ll probably enjoy working with us.


How to apply

  • Apply through LinkedIn Easy Apply.
  • If we like your profile, we’ll reach out and ask for your portfolio (if you haven’t provided it yet) and a quick call.
  • If you do well in the call, you’ll get hired. Easy.


Hope to see you soon!

title: Executive Search Consultant
description:
About Gold & Aron:

Gold & Aron Conseil is a boutique executive search firm with a 20+ year track record of placing top-tier talent in the Technology and Financial Services industries across the Americas and Europe.


About the Role

We are hiring an Executive Search Senior Associate to support Gold & Aron CEO and COO across high-impact searches in Technology and Financial Services in a premium boutique environment. The role blends deep research, pipeline development, and end-to-end recruiting for select mid-level roles. You’ll help build the engine that enables leadership to focus on client strategy and firm growth.


WHAT YOU WILL DO


Candidate Research & Sourcing for senior level searches (60%)

  • Build and manage strong candidate pipelines across multiple concurrent searches.
  • Active search: Conduct structured research, market mapping using several tech tools including Linkedin, AI tools and own data base.
  • Passive search: Source, screen applicants
  • Lead candidate scoring, initial candidate assessment


End to end Recruiting for selected mid level searches (30%)

  • Build and manage candidate pipeline
  • Conduct first-round screens to assess fit and motivation.
  • Prepare concise candidate summaries and search updates.
  • Support client communications and progress check-ins.
  • Coordinate interviews and every other step of the hiring process.


Business Development Support (10%)

  • Research companies, markets, and potential clients
  • Build prospect lists and market intelligence for the CEO and COO.
  • Bring new ideas, new BD initiatives for the company


IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE

  • 3–7+ years in research, consulting, finance, tech, recruiting, or similar fields.
  • Experience in or recruiting for Tech or Financial Services is a strong plus.
  • Advanced English + Native Portuguese is a must. Spanish is a strong plus.
  • Analytical, structured thinker with strong organization and attention to detail.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity; bias for action; strong ownership mindset.
  • Bachelor’s degree mandatory.
  • Location: Brazil remote. Preference for São Paulo, SP.

title: Elixir Backend Developer
description:
Company Description

Founded in 2015, DevGrid is a full-stack software development consultancy dedicated to enabling innovation and digital transformation for businesses. With expertise in cutting-edge technologies like IoT, AI, Machine Learning, Blockchain, and more, we have successfully delivered over 20 products to clients globally. Based in the United Kingdom with delivery hubs in Brazil, we serve a diverse client base, including tech start-ups and large organizations in the UK, Europe, and the USA. DevGrid is driven by a strong company culture, a focus on collaboration, and a talented team of engineers to bring innovative business visions to life.

Role Description

We are seeking a talented Elixir Backend Developer for a full-time, remote position. As an Elixir Backend Developer, you will design, develop, and maintain back-end applications and systems using Elixir. Your day-to-day tasks will involve writing well-structured, efficient code, collaborating with other developers and stakeholders, and ensuring software quality and performance. Additionally, you will contribute to system architecture design, troubleshoot issues, and continually improve project functionality.

Qualifications
  • Experience in Back-End Web Development and strong command of Elixir
  • Proficiency in Software Development and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
  • Familiarity with Front-End Development and the ability to work collaboratively with front-end teams
  • Strong programming skills and knowledge of best practices in software engineering
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities and attention to detail
  • Experience with scalable applications and system architecture design is a plus
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a remote team
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field or equivalent practical experience

description:
Somos a maior multinacional brasileira e estamos entre as 100 maiores empresas de TI do mundo. Estamos presentes em 41 países com mais de 30 mil colaboradores. A Stefanini tem como principal objetivo auxiliar os clientes a encontrar, por meio de soluções personalizadas, a maneira ideal para alcançar seus desafios, impulsionando a inovação digital. E queremos mais!


  • Atuação 100% remoto.


Responsabilidades:

  • Utilizar copilots de IA (como GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot ou similares) para criar, revisar e otimizar código, aumentando a produtividade e a eficiência do desenvolvimento de software.
  • Desenvolver e manter soluções utilizando linguagens de programação C#, entre outras.
  • Trabalhar em plataformas Microsoft (M365, Power Platform, Dynamics, Azure) para desenvolver soluções integradas e inovadoras.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de versionamento de código utilizando Git/GitHub, garantindo organização e rastreabilidade dos projetos.
  • Colaborar na implementação de estratégias de segurança, compliance e governança no uso de IA, assegurando a conformidade com políticas internas e regulamentações externas.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as tendências de IA aplicada ao desenvolvimento e propor a adoção de novas tecnologias e metodologias.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência prática com ferramentas de copilots de IA, como GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot ou soluções similares.
  • Conhecimento avançado em linguagens de programação como C#;
  • Familiaridade com plataformas Microsoft (M365, Power Platform, Dynamics, Azure).
  • Compreensão sólida de boas práticas de versionamento de código e uso de ferramentas como Git/GitHub.
  • Noções de segurança, compliance e governança relacionadas ao uso de IA em ambientes corporativos.
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe, colaborar em projetos multidisciplinares e compartilhar conhecimento sobre os benefícios da IA no desenvolvimento.

Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição

Academia Stefanini - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado

title: Sr. SAP Developer – CPI (Cloud Platform Integration) – Advanced English
description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Responsibilities :

Design and implement integrations using SAP CPI between cloud and on-premise systems

Monitor and troubleshoot integration flows and APIs

Ensure secure data exchange and compliance with enterprise standards

Collaborate with SAP BASIS and functional teams for seamless connectivity


Skill/Qualifications:

Proficiency with ABAP Objects, including custom class and interface creation, and familiarity with standard objects such as ALV tables

Experience with the SAP Data Dictionary, including creating custom tables, enhancement techniques including exits and BADI’s, custom table maintenance dialogs, and working with other Dictionary objects such as domains, data elements, and search helps

Experience with system integration via ALE, REST API, OData, CPI, CPI-DS, or other BTP products.

Knowledge of the lock object concept, including custom lock object creation and managing locking operations within programs

Experience analyzing, troubleshooting, and reprocessing IDocs

Understanding of batch job scheduling, with experience using SM37 to review batch jobs

Knowledge of SAP authorization object concepts

Experience supporting upgrades (SPAU/SPDD) during upgrades and evaluating/applying SAP Notes

Experience developing and supporting custom IDocs/workflows

Expertise in ABAP Objects, including inheritance, polymorphism, persistent objects, events, dynamic programming with RTTS, and advanced ALV tools such as trees

Experience with performance tuning using tools such as Runtime Analysis, SQL Tracer, and Code Inspector

Knowledge of CDS views; experience developing with Eclipse/ADT

Experience developing with SAP Fiori

Understanding of integration points between Coupa and SAP

Experience leading complex projects and coordinating work amongst a cross-functional team

Experience with certificates, cipher, Host certificates and SSL


Language Requirement:

Advanced English


Additional Requirement:

Availability to relocate to Mexico after 3 months and remain there for the duration of the contract


Why choose us?

We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented

We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues from all over the world

We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good integration between your work and personal life, with real flexibility

We are committed to your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at all levels to help you find your unique brilliance. We offer comprehensive benefits to all employees

We are certified as a "Great Place to Work" and "Top Employer" in 17 countries, and recognized as a “Top Employer” in Brazil specifically, offering a positive work environment that values employee recognition and respect



Equality & Opportunity for All

Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws

title: Limpador - Colaboração Paga (Consultoria Técnica)
description:
Título: Especialista em Limpeza | Colaboração Paga (Consultoria Técnica)


Descrição:

A mybest Brasil está em busca de um(a) profissional com experiência prática em limpeza doméstica para colaborar como consultor(a) especialista em nossos guias de compra e artigos sobre produtos e ferramentas para o lar.


Entre os temas que abordamos estão limpadores para azulejos e rejuntes, repelentes de pragas, aspiradores de pó, máquinas de lavar e outros produtos usados no dia a dia da casa .


Como funciona a colaboração:

  • Questionário: responder um breve formulário online indicando os critérios mais importantes para escolher cada tipo de produto (efetividade, segurança, facilidade de uso, durabilidade, custo-benefício, o que evitar etc.).
  • Revisão do artigo: revisar o rascunho antes da publicação para garantir precisão técnica e clareza nas recomendações.
  • Crédito: seu nome e mini bio aparecerão como especialista no artigo. Se tiver site ou blog profissional , incluímos o link no perfil (excelente oportunidade para aumentar sua autoridade e visibilidade).


Condições da colaboração:

  • Pagamento: R$ 350 por artigo (questionário + revisão).
  • Pagamento realizado até o dia 20 do mês seguinte à entrega.
  • Colaboração pontual, 100% remota.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência comprovada em limpeza e organização residencial , com conhecimento prático sobre produtos e utensílios domésticos.
  • Capacidade de emitir NFS-e de serviço de consultoria por CNPJ próprio fora do regime MEI .
  • Possuir site ou blog profissional ativo (não apenas redes sociais).


Desejável:

  • Familiaridade com Google Docs e Google Forms .
  • Clareza e objetividade ao transformar experiência prática em recomendações úteis para o público.


Observação:

Recebemos um volume alto de candidaturas e priorizamos respostas rápidas. Entraremos em contato por e-mail apenas com os candidatos cujo perfil atender às necessidades do projeto.


Sobre a mybest:

A mybest é a maior plataforma de recomendações de produtos do Japão, com operação em mais de 10 países, incluindo o Brasil. Nossos conteúdos combinam pesquisa editorial com a experiência de especialistas para ajudar milhões de leitores a comprar com segurança e confiança.


Se você é profissional de limpeza e quer compartilhar seu conhecimento com um público amplo, candidate-se e conte um pouco sobre sua experiência!

title: Consultor(a) de Field Marketing Senior (BR)
description:
Você na Deloitte!



Você terá a oportunidade de evoluir sua carreira na organização com o portfólio de serviços profissionais mais diversificado do mundo, atuando como Consultor(a) de Field Marketing Senior no time da Deloitte Digital , que busca promover inovação e transformação digital em nossos clientes . Na sua rotina, você irá:



  • Definir, planejar e implementar a estratégia de Go-to-Market para a região/país, alinhada aos objetivos globais e regionais;
  • Liderar o planejamento e a execução de campanhas e iniciativas de marketing (digitais, presenciais e híbridas) em todos os canais, com foco em geração de demanda e pipeline;
  • Adaptar campanhas globais e regionais para o mercado local e desenvolver novas campanhas específicas para a região, incluindo a criação de conteúdo relevante;
  • Gerenciar o orçamento de marketing, garantindo a alocação eficaz de recursos e o acompanhamento dos resultados financeiros;
  • Acompanhar a efetividade das campanhas, a geração de leads e o impacto no pipeline, reportando os resultados e propondo ações de melhoria contínua;
  • Coordenar e executar eventos de Field Marketing (virtuais, híbridos e presenciais), desde a seleção de fornecedores e logística até a gestão de conteúdo, palestrantes e processos de inscrição;
  • Colaborar com as equipes de Vendas, Marketing e Liderança para garantir o alinhamento estratégico e o sucesso das iniciativas conjuntas;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as últimas tendências e melhores práticas em marketing de campo, tecnologias e o cenário competitivo.



Acreditamos na força dos talentos que preparamos. Eles transformam de fato, impactam organizações, impulsionam mais talentos e criam oportunidades. Que tal fazer parte da maior organização de serviços profissionais do mundo? Escolha seu impacto.



Requisitos



O que precisa para você se candidatar a vaga?



  • Experiência comprovada em Field Marketing, Marketing de Canais, Alianças ou função similar em Marketing B2B;
  • Experiência sólida no desenvolvimento e implementação de estratégias de Go-to-Market e campanhas integradas;
  • Experiência prática na organização e gestão de eventos, incluindo gestão de fornecedores e análise de ROI;
  • Comprovada experiência em campanhas de geração de demanda, marketing de conteúdo e estratégias de engajamento de clientes/parceiros;
  • Fluência em Inglês (desejável Espanhol);
  • Graduação em Marketing, Publicidade, Administração ou área correlata;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens (10-20%), se necessário.



Desejável:



  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de automação de marketing (ex: Marketo, HubSpot) e CRM (ex: Salesforce).



Beneficios



O que estará disponível para você ?



Desenvolvimento profissional



É claro que cuidaríamos do seu desenvolvimento aqui na Deloitte! Queremos que você alcance seus objetivos profissionais e pessoais e, por isso, contamos com Universidade Corporativa, acesso a plataformas online de aprendizado, plataforma de idiomas com mais de 7.500 conteúdos e cerca de 60 cursos divididos por nível, área de atuação, habilidades profissionais e interesses, e até uma plataforma que reúne diversas instituições de ensino, fornecendo descontos exclusivos para profissionais Deloitte e seus dependentes.



Além disso, oferecemos um plano de carreira estruturado, com mentoria de profissionais da Deloitte por meio de um(a) coach, que poderá ouvir seus desafios e apoiar para que consiga evoluir tanto com habilidades técnicas, quanto com habilidades comportamentais com base na própria experiência. É ótimo ter uma pessoa mentora, não é mesmo?



Cuidados com o seu bem-estar


Aqui na Deloitte, acreditamos que saúde e bem-estar não são apenas projetos, e sim uma mudança de cultura. Queremos que você coloque em prática todo o seu talento e desenvolva uma carreira de sucesso com a gente, com equilíbrio entre Mente, Corpo e Propósito. Para isso, contamos com mais de 30 benefícios, como:



  • Serviço de telemedicina para que você consiga fazer uma pré-avaliação sem precisar sair de casa!
  • Family Strategy: programa destinados à profissionais gestantes e futuros papais que terão todo apoio possível neste momento tão especial
  • Wellhub (Gympass) para colocar os exercícios físicos em dia
  • Dia de folga no mês do seu aniversário, para celebrar uma das pessoas mais importantes de sua vida
  • Canal de apoio psicológico e Serviço Social



(Mais) Benefícios



  • Assistência médica e odontológica! Para que você faça check-ups e cuide de você, em primeiro lugar
  • Participação nos lucros. Afinal, sem os nossos talentos, não poderíamos crescer exponencialmente
  • Auxílio-internet, para apoiar no trabalho em modelo híbrido
  • Seguro de vida
  • Cartão Multibenefícios*



*Você receberá um valor em seu cartão e poderá distribuí-lo entre as opções que melhor se adequam às suas necessidades de acordo com as regras do programa.



Oportunidade de fazer parte de uma cultura inclusiva na Deloitte Brasil



Você pode ser quem realmente é com oportunidade igual de crescimento. Para reforçar esse compromisso, desenvolvemos a estratégia D&I com os 5 pilares – Origens, Delas, LGBT+, Inclui e Gerações. Destacamos que todas as nossas vagas estão abertas ao público PcD.



Esperamos você neste time!

title: Data Engineer
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Python Data Engineer with an AI/ML focus to join our client’s growing data & analytics team in Brazil. This role is ideal for someone who loves building scalable data pipelines, operationalizing machine learning workflows, and partnering closely with data scientists to bring models into production.


You will design, develop, and maintain data infrastructure that powers AI-driven insights across the organization, including data models and pipelines that run through Snowflake . This is a fully remote position working with cross-functional product, engineering, and analytics teams.


Key Responsibilities

  • Build, optimize, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, modern data engineering frameworks, and Snowflake as a central data warehouse.
  • Architect and manage data workflows , ensuring accuracy, scalability, and reliability.
  • Work closely with data scientists to deploy, monitor, and tune machine learning models .
  • Develop feature engineering pipelines , preprocessing workflows, and model-serving APIs.
  • Integrate data from various sources (APIs, databases, cloud storage, streaming platforms).
  • Implement MLOps best practices including versioning, CI/CD for ML, and automated retraining workflows.
  • Optimize data storage, compute usage, and performance within Snowflake and cloud-native tools (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Create and maintain documentation, data catalogs, and operational guides.
  • Monitor data system performance and recommend improvements.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–7+ years of experience as a Data Engineer , Python Engineer , or similar backend/data role.
  • Strong proficiency in Python , including building production-grade data pipelines.
  • Experience with Snowflake —data modeling, Snowpipe, tasks, streams, stored procedures, and performance optimization.
  • Experience with AI/ML workflows : feature engineering, inference pipelines, or deploying models.
  • Proficiency in SQL and relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server).
  • Hands-on experience with at least one cloud platform (AWS , GCP , or Azure ).
  • Experience using data orchestration tools like Airflow , Prefect , or Dagster .
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Vertex AI , or similar.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling, data warehousing, and distributed systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Spark , Databricks , or other big-data processing tools.
  • Experience ingesting and transforming data at scale on Snowflake , including optimization of virtual warehouses.
  • Familiarity with Kafka , Kinesis , or other streaming platforms.
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, etc.).
  • Exposure to deep learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch).
  • Experience working with Brazilian clients or LATAM distributed engineering teams.

title: Frontend Developer
description:
Company Description

Moveo.AI is a fast-growing conversational AI company with teams in New York, São Paulo, and Athens. We build proactive AI agents powered by our own LLMs, helping enterprises like Kaizen Gaming, Edenred, and Allianz deliver high-impact customer experiences. Our platform handles millions of monthly interactions and is built by a tight, engineering-driven team that moves fast and solves real problems.


Role Description

We are looking for a Front-end Engineer with strong React experience. This is a full-time hybrid role based in São Paulo. You will work on the web tooling that powers our AI platform, building user interfaces that are fast, reliable, and easy to use. You will implement complex flows, connect to our APIs, manage client-side state, and ensure a smooth experience across browsers and devices. You will collaborate closely with product, design, and backend engineers to ship high-quality features in an iterative way.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of front-end engineering experience
  • Strong hands-on experience with React
  • Solid experience with TypeScript
  • Experience with Shadcn UI components
  • Experience with state management (Redux or similar)
  • Experience with React Query or similar data-fetching libraries
  • Good understanding of modern front-end architecture and patterns
  • Experience integrating with REST APIs (GraphQL is a plus)
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills
